paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 91:9; R' Chanina and R' Marinum reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב״ר פצ״א-ט is read as Bereshit Rabbah chapter 91, section 9, without independent named-edition verification. Chanina and Marinum report in Nehorai’s name.

Marinum retains supplied מרינום without identification. Older machine תנינא/מרינ differ from supplied חנינא/מרינום; no fresh printed check is claimed. Abba is explicit; both other personal title abbreviations remain R'.
